views.label: Where the time goes
views.note: Detection dominates: the heartbeat silence window is the whole cost.

views.label: The recovery work
views.note: The four recovery steps together cost half a second in the design.

views.label: The headroom
views.note: The promised budget against the work that is actually left to run.

spans.name: The failing generation
spans.detail: The node dies mid-generation, so the stream stops without a result.

spans.name: Recover the job
spans.detail: Everything the broker does between the failure and the resumed work.

spans.name: Detect the node loss
spans.detail: The watchdog waits out heartbeat.timeout_seconds before it believes the node is gone.

spans.name: Load the newest snapshot
spans.detail: EdgeRecord first, the local journal when the ledger is down.

spans.name: Validate against the job
spans.detail: Prompt hash and model must match, or the job restarts clean.

spans.name: Re-dispatch elsewhere
spans.detail: Directly, never through the shared queue, never onto the node that failed.

spans.name: Resume from the decode step
spans.detail: The recorded partial tokens are replayed, so finished work is not repeated.

spans.name: The resumed generation
spans.detail: The design does not bound the resumed generation, so the span has no recorded end.

spans.name: The 30 s recovery budget
spans.detail: The outer bound the plan promises; the design spends 6.5 s of it.

cards.title: These are designed budgets, not a trace
items: The evidence flag is illustrative: no profiler run backs these numbers
Every duration comes from the documented fault timeline and the shipped defaults
The bar lengths are the documented design, not a measurement

cards.title: Detection is the cost
items: Six of the 6.5 seconds are the heartbeat silence window
The recovery work itself is five hundred milliseconds in the design
A shorter heartbeat interval buys back detection time at the cost of chatter

cards.title: What the design guarantees
items: A transient socket error does not terminally fail the running job
The quarantine has an explicit expiry and placement honors it
The recovery budget is bounded separately from the resumed generation
